{{Quote|What in the name of the Force ''happened'' out there?''"<br />"''This was a ''repair yard'' before the Clone Wars erupted, Commander&hellip;now it's just so much ''dead space''.|[[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Outgunned" />}}
A '''repair yard''' was located near [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], in the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
{{Quote|General Grievous's armada used this area for ''target practice'' a while back. Probably ''finished off'' whatever had been left behind.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Outgunned" />}}
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this location in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] was used as a [[Shipyard/Legends|repair yard]]. During the war, it was abandoned by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Later, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] used this area for target practice, finishing off whatever had been left behind by the Republic.<ref name="Outgunned" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the abandoned repair yard was filled with a number of derelict [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droid starfighters]], [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]], a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class core ship]] and an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]. It was also inhabited by [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]].<ref name="Outgunned" />
